title: Verio Flex Meter readings on Nightscout
body:
I have the One Touch Verio Flex Meter syncing via wifi to Xdrip on my phone ok but reading not showing on Nightscout website I put in the REST-API Base URL but don't see the meter points on the website I see them on the Xdrip on my phone ok are these reading included. 

My Dexcom G5 is on order and wanted to get everything setup before it arrives

comments.body:
Ok I ran a report and the readings are showing on the report
[Meter Readings.pdf](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/files/1850632/Meter.Readings.pdf)
 so the data is getting to the database just not displaying on live feed
I'm not sure if this is an issue or not? Perhaps ask Nightscout team why this would be?
Not sure but now all is working got Dexcom setup insurance wouldn't cover my verio using Countour Next One nice compact meter and works great with xdrip and more accurate
